newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Fruitfed sees difficult trading continuing.
newsitem.headline: Fruitfed sees difficult trading continuing.

text.p: Fruit distributor Fruitfed Supplies Ltd said on Wednesday it expects difficult trading conditions to continue into the current year and intense pressure on customer returns to have a direct bearing on the company result.
The launch of further new products, particularly in the plant nutrition sector, would assist to develop additional sales and profits, Fruitfed said.
"However the pressures on our customers' returns is intense and this will have a direct bearing on the company results."
Fruitfed reported a tax paid profit for the year to March 31 of $1.072 million, down from $1.486 million in the previous year.
This was achieved on sales of $57.2 million, down from $63.5 million in the previous year.
